name: og_31_protometabolism_to_amphiphiles
description: Study 31: do amphiphiles assemble into a membrane? Drives real Martini 3 CG MD (viva-openmm) on a generated POPE bilayer; minimize+NVT relaxes the clashy initial placement into a bound bilayer so the potential energy settles negative — the membrane-cohesion / assembly signal. Reports PE/KE (cohesion), static area-per-lipid and lipid count. Charged-intermediate permeability (PMF) is the documented follow-up.

platform.description: OpenMM platform (OpenCL=Metal GPU; CPU/Reference also valid)

minimize.description: Energy-minimize the clashy initial placement first
